blocks.text: Last updated at 9:51 p.m., Nov. 1, 2026 CEBU CITY, Philippines — Three separate fires were reported in Cebu City and Lapu-Lapu City on Sunday, November 1, as residents observed All Saints’ Day, one of the days of the season locally known as Kalag-Kalag. Two of the fires broke out in Barangays Lahug and Mambaling in Cebu City, while another was reported in Barangay Canjulao in Lapu-Lapu City. Authorities said the fire in Mambaling reached the third alarm.
